title: Guardian Case File "NTOC2024 Possible UAPs [Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena] Hovering Near Rolling Meadows, IL. [Illinois]," January 8, 2025
doc_notes: This is an FBI Guardian case file documenting a UAP sighting report in Rolling Meadows, IL, which was investigated and subsequently closed due to lack of corroborating sensor data.

encounters.summary: A civilian reported seeing three or four glowing orbs hovering in the sky over Rolling Meadows, IL, which appeared as round circles with moving parts when viewed through a telescope.
encounters.entity_appearance: glowing orbs, round circles with stuff moving around them, bright yellow/white light, diamond shape
encounters.quote: look like round circles with stuff moving around them up close
